glid.description: Seller GLID (fk_glusr_usr_id) for this call, supplied by the campaign or test call.
glid.name: glid

seller_found.description: yes when the seller was found in the persona database
seller_found.name: seller_found

call_allowed.description: yes, no (seller asked not to be called) or unknown (seller record unavailable)
call_allowed.name: call_allowed

business_name.description: Business name to confirm at the start of the call
business_name.name: business_name

opening_greeting.value: Hello, this is VANI calling from IndiaMART about your business listing. Am I speaking with the business owner?
opening_greeting.description: Exact first line of the call: asks for the business by name, or a general greeting when no name is on record
opening_greeting.name: opening_greeting

switch_language.description: Most likely language if the seller switches
switch_language.name: switch_language

language_style.value: medium Hinglish with common trade words; respectful, aap and ji
language_style.name: language_style

delivery_style.value: calm, unhurried pace; warmth high, empathy high, assertiveness low
delivery_style.description: Pace and tone for this seller
delivery_style.name: delivery_style

call_objective.value: Seller record could not be checked. First get permission: only after a clear yes, ask about buyer enquiries and offer a 15 to 20 minute meeting with a sales executive. Any other answer: thank the user and close.
call_objective.name: call_objective

opening_plan.value: Confirm the business name, then ask one question only: is the user open to a two minute conversation about their IndiaMART listing. Stop and wait. Continue only on a clear yes; for maybe, later, not sure or no, thank the user and end the call. Share no seller details and suggest no package.
opening_plan.name: opening_plan

seller_facts.description: Verified facts the agent may use
seller_facts.name: seller_facts

previous_commitment.description: Earlier callback or meeting to acknowledge
previous_commitment.name: previous_commitment

objection_guidance.value: Any reluctance: accept it at once, thank the user and close.
objection_guidance.description: Handling for this seller's known objections
objection_guidance.name: objection_guidance

call_ref.description: Unique id for this call; sent back with the switch log and the outcome
call_ref.name: call_ref

recommended_package.value: none: do not suggest a package on this call
recommended_package.description: Package suggested for this seller's turnover, with its price in words
recommended_package.name: recommended_package

package_pitch.description: Benefits and reason the suggested package fits
package_pitch.name: package_pitch

call_outcome.post_interaction_prompt: Classify the final outcome of the call from the transcript. meeting_fixed only when the seller clearly agreed to a meeting time. callback_requested when a specific callback day or time was agreed. already_in_touch only when the seller says they are already talking to an IndiaMART sales executive about packages or services. complaint when the call was mainly about an unresolved complaint, poor service, or the seller being on a call with customer care. not_interested only when the refusal was unambiguous. Otherwise choose the closest value or other.
call_outcome.name: call_outcome

meeting_time.post_interaction_prompt: The meeting date and time the seller agreed to, exactly as agreed, or empty.
meeting_time.name: meeting_time

callback_time.post_interaction_prompt: The callback date and time the seller asked for, or empty.
callback_time.name: callback_time

objections_raised.post_interaction_prompt: Short list of the objections the seller raised, separated by semicolons, or empty.
objections_raised.name: objections_raised

persona_switches.post_interaction_prompt: List every point where the agent changed its delivery because of the seller's behaviour (frustration, confusion, interest, language switch, rush, bot suspicion). For each: signal detected, the seller's words, change made, reason. Separate entries with semicolons. Empty if none.
persona_switches.name: persona_switches

call_summary.post_interaction_prompt: A short 1-2 line description of what happened on the call.
call_summary.name: call_summary

body.name: signal
body.description: The signal detected in the seller's last turn

body.name: change_made
body.description: The delivery change made, in English

body.name: reason
body.description: Why the change was made, in English, tied to what the seller said

body.name: seller_quote
body.description: The seller's words that showed the signal, as heard

voicemail_message: Hello, this is VANI from IndiaMART calling about your business listing and buyer enquiries. We will call you back at a better time. Thank you.
